title: kaava reconcile command runs marker scanning outside the interface process
context: Alternative approaches: scan from within the React interface; background task in the Tauri main thread; no reconciliation.
decision: The `kaava reconcile` command (a binary in `crates/schematify-reconcile`) runs marker-token scanning outside the interface process. It reads `.kaava/nodes/`, scans the working tree, and writes `runs/<node-uuid>/reconcile.json` for every node. Schematify reads the written file through `schematify_reconcile_status` but never scans the working tree itself.
consequences: Scanning does not block the UI; projects with huge source trees can scan in background CI; Tauri main thread stays responsive; binary can be used in CI pipelines independently; design UI has no direct access to source code.
